parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same root cause: on the denial path, refilled tokens are stored in bucket.tokens but bucket.updated_at is not advanced, so the same elapsed interval is credited again on the next call, letting throttled clients exceed the configured rate. Description A gives a line-73 location and a worked example; Description B cites lines 69-73 and a polling example. The defect and its consequence match.
